name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This balances visibility for low-vision users with minimal layout shift for screen-reader users. The trade-off is slightly less emphasis than a 3px ring, but it keeps the page stable when focus moves.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets contrast on both light and dark, and the larger offset reduces layout shift. Settle by testing with real users and a contrast checker.
